newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lebanon says Israel doing nothing to restore calm.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon says Israel doing nothing to restore calm.

text.p: Lebanese Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri accused Israel on Saturday of doing nothing to help restore calm in the Palestinian territories after four days of fierce fighting in which nearly 70 people have died.

"Until now Israel has not taken a single step towards calming the situation," Hariri told reporters after an hour of talks with French President Jacqeus Chirac in Paris. "It seems to me that (Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin) Netanyahu is doing everything to destroy the peace process."
During their talks, Hariri and Chirac made a joint appeal for a de-escalation and a return to reason in the Middle East, a Chirac aide told reporters.
"Both men spoke of their deep concern about the current situation and the need to begin working on a process to reduce tensions," the aide said without offering specifics.
The two men also discussed Chirac's planned visit to Lebanon in October, presidential aides said.
Chirac will travel to Lebanon as part of a Middle East tour also taking him to Syria, Israel, Jordan and the Palestinian territories, they said. A precise date has not yet been set for the trip.
